answer.reason: Savers is a for-profit thrift retailer selling donated secondhand goods to value-seeking shoppers. Upbound is a lease-to-own and fintech business. It leases new durable goods through Rent-A-Center and Acima, and offers the Brigit app. The two share only a loose low-budget consumer angle. Their products, revenue models and sourcing differ, so they are not peers.

T:P1.1.text: Savers: Second Hand Used Clothing Thrift & Vintage Store

T:P1.2.text: With multiple thrift stores in the U.S., Canada, and Australia you're sure to find great deals on clothing, accessories, hard goods, electronics, books, home goods, and more.

T:P1.4.text: Join the Club Text BONUS to 53955

T:P1.5.text: Both coupons are valid for 14 days once received. See coupon for details. Both require consent to Super Savers Club® program terms and privacy policy. See savers.com/super-savers/program-terms for both program details. *For first-time signups with valid email only. Coupon will be emailed. **Valid for first-time text message subscribers only; available to existing Super Savers Club® members and new members joining by text message. Coupon will be texted. Standard message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.

T:P1.6.text: For nearly 70 years, our business has driven significant community and environmental impact.

T:P1.7.text: We pay our nonprofit partners for your stuff, helping them fund programs in your community.

T:P1.8.text: Your one-of-a-kind finds are given a second chance to be loved again by thrifters like you.

T:P1.9.text: Together, we champion reuse and keep millions of reusable items out of landfills every year.

T:P1.10.text: We can’t do it without you.

T:P2.2.text: Since our humble thrift shop beginnings, we've come a long way in the secondhand space.

T:P2.3.text: Committed to making secondhand second nature.

T:P2.4.text: Since our humble thrift shop beginnings, we’ve come a long way in the secondhand space. We’ve grown from a single shop to a global reuse champion—and it’s all because of you.

T:P2.5.text: It’s the thrill of finding “this is exactly what I need,” the “why not,” and “where’d you get that?!” It’s one-of-a-kind finds for one-of-a-kind people. It’s reusing, repurposing, and upcycling, helping save the planet while saving a few bucks. This is thrift.

T:P2.6.text: Thrift is what you make it. You’ve turned secondhand goods into first-rate fashion and made pre-loved looks feel pretty unbelievable. While we’re honored to fill our racks with one-of-a-kind finds, they don’t really come to life until you make them yours. So, thank you for shopping, styling, and redefining what it means to shop secondhand.

T:P2.7.text: We couldn’t be more Thrift Proud®—and hope you are, too.

T:P2.8.text: Back our first thrift shop called an old movie theater in San Francisco’s Mission District home. From day one, we gave shoppers what they were looking for: stylish finds at unbelievable savings.

T:P2.9.text: Since then, we’ve opened stores across the U.S., Canada, and Australia and have consistently partnered with local nonprofit organizations.

T:P2.10.text: We’ve chosen to keep our business model this way—to buy our supply from local nonprofits. But we didn’t stop there. We’ve also created a leading recycling and reuse program, where we keep millions of pounds of reusable items out of area landfills every year.

C:P1.2.text: We exist to elevate financial opportunity for all

C:P1.3.text: Putting the needs of our customers at the forefront of everything we do

C:P1.4.text: Co-creating success and value by supporting each other

C:P1.5.text: Promoting upward movement and financial confidence

C:P1.6.text: Treating all individuals equally with empathy, dignity and consideration

C:P1.7.text: Keeping our products and services easy to understand and use

C:P1.8.text: Creating meaningful change in our communities

C:P1.9.text: Our family of brands designed to provide elevated financial opportunities and potential for our customers and partners

C:P1.10.text: Our Acima Leasing business is a best in-class lease-to-own technology platform, providing consumers with an alternative to traditional financing and the ability to select durable goods from a wide range of retailers and providing retailers with increased business opportunities

C:P1.11.text: Our Brigit business helps customers budget better, get their earned wages early, build their credit through savings, protect themselves from identity theft, and find ways to earn and save money via a holistic financial health app

C:P1.12.text: Our Rent-A-Center business offers a flexible and easy omni-channel lease-to-own solution for customers to furnish their homes and access other durable goods they need and enjoy, affordably and without incurring a long-term obligation or relying on credit to finance a purchase

C:P2.2.text: We offer innovative technology-driven solutions for our customers and retail partners across our multiple brands.

C:P2.3.text: Acima Leasing is a technology company based in Draper, Utah, that focuses on providing flexible lease-to-own solutions for customers across a wide range of durable goods and retailers. The company has partnered with thousands of retailers to offer its lease-to-own options at the point of sale. Upbound Group, Inc.

C:P2.4.text: Brigit is a holistic financial health app based in New York City, New York that helps customers budget better, get their earned wages early, build their credit through savings, protect themselves from identity theft, and find ways to earn and save money. Brigit helps everyday Americans build a better financial future.

C:P2.5.text: Rent-A-Center was and is based in Plano, Texas. The company specializes in renting furniture, appliances, electronics, and computers to customers with flexible lease-to-own payment options and the option to purchase or return the items at any time. The company has grown rapidly over the years, with multiple locations across the United States and Puerto Rico.

C:P2.6.text: Get It Now! and Home Choice offer a retail installment sale option at multiple stores in Wisconsin and Minnesota and offer customers a convenient way to own the best name brands in furniture, appliances, electronics and computers today.

C:P2.7.text: RAC Mexico consists of multiple stores across Mexico that offer customers with little or no credit history the ability to rent with the option to buy goods from the best brands of furniture, appliances, computers, electronics, cell phones, mattresses and motorcycles.
